messages:
Priya Patel: Quick heads up — contract credits for account `redwood-dedicated-42` didn't get applied to Feb invoice INV-2026-02. Contract RD-DED-763 showed $12,000 credit (monthly amortized) but invoice line missing it. Can finance reconcile? cc @Alex @Sam :eyes:

Alex Chen: On it. can you paste the invoice snippet or ledger export? I'll triage with GA billing team.

Priya Patel: pasted below (only redacted):
```
Invoice INV-2026-02
Line 1: Reserved capacity charge - $15,000
Line 2: Promo credit - $0 (expected -$12,000)
Line 3: Usage - $2,300
Total: $17,300
```

Samir Gupta: Did the contract start in Jan? Are these credits amortized monthly or applied up-front? If amortized, ledger should show a recurring credit line.

Priya Patel: Contract start 2026-01-10, terms show monthly amortization over 12 months.

billing-bot: Automated notice — Promo credits for RD-DED-763 expire 2026-03-01. Remaining balance: $0.

Alex Chen: Hmm — if promo credits expired before being applied they won't show. Priya, can you confirm if the invoice period includes the commitment activation? If it did, we can open a retro credit request with the provider.

Priya Patel: Invoice period 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28, commitment activation logged 2026-01-10 so should have applied.

Samir Gupta: Suggest opening a billing ticket with the cloud provider and include the ledger export + contract PDF. Also add this internal ticket for tracking: FIN-BILL-7892.

Alex Chen: Filed internal ticket FIN-BILL-7892 and external ticket CLOUD-BILL-2154. Linking ledger: https://billing.redwood.example/ledger?acct=redwood-dedicated-42

Priya Patel: thanks — added contract PDF to FIN-BILL-7892. If provider refuses, can we escalate to reseller / CSM to request exception? :thinking_face:

Alex Chen: Yes, escalate path OK. I'll keep updates in the ticket. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Note added to FIN-BILL-7892 by Alex Chen — awaiting provider response.
